data: Original 157 gold and 1014 masked training rows only. No validation/test fitting. Exclude masked duplicates of every held-out embedding group.
shortlist: Top ordinary and robust training-CV policies from each family (up to four). Each policy fixes a model, threshold and scope before repeat CV.
validation_policy: Freeze finalists before loading validation labels. At most two per family; report even unsuccessful results. Preserve prior winner unless validation sample F1 improves.
controls: No-exchange co-training controls for each metadata view. Original-distance kernel equivalence check. Baseline evaluated on matching split seeds.
restrictions: No deep learning, external data/labels, ID predictors, or final train-plus-validation refit.

literature.use: Two distinct feature views exchanging labels; our weight and agreement variants are adaptations.
Gold-only per-reason linear distance learning before an SVM. Shrink toward original distances.

matched_ablation: After selecting the co-training policy from repeated CV, evaluate exactly the same learner settings, scope and decoder with label exchange disabled. No control-specific tuning. This adds one validation control within the cap of four.
unsupervised_step: Both approaches fit KMeans on permitted gold+masked embeddings; confident gold cluster agreement downweights conflicting pseudo-labels.
